Name: Norm's Country Kitchen (Food Truck)
Author: ichortower
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Meet Norm[/u][/b][/size]

[size=3]Norm is an ordinary, no-nonsense sort of guy who drives his truck from place to place and sells his specialty foods. He isn't much of a talker, nor is he a sentimental sort. He loves simple pleasures, like food, and likes to listen to his radio while he works (if you have the optional Positional Audio mod installed, you will be able to hear the radio while he's open).[/size]


[size=5][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/size]
[*][size=3]SMAPI 4.1.10+[/size]
[*][size=3]Content Patcher 2.6+[/size]
[*][size=3]Positional Audio 1.0+ (optional; used only to enable hearing Norm's music)[/size]
[/list]

[size=5][b][u]Unlocking[/u][/b]
[/size]
[size=3]Norm and his truck will become available automatically after you have played for at least 10 days. On the next Monday, Lewis will send you a letter about the truck. Starting from the day after that, Norm will come to town every Tuesday, including for the Stardew Valley Fair on Fall 16.[/size]

[size=3]On non-festival days, the truck is open for business from 8:00 am until 5:00 pm. At the Fair, his truck is available near Gus's barbecue, but he won't play his radio. Unlike the barbecue, you still have to buy Norm's food.[/size]


[size=5][b][u]Making a Friend[/u][/b]
[/size]
[size=3]Norm doesn't have any heart events or any other content of that sort, but he's a real NPC and you can befriend him (doing so is not required for Perfection). If you do, then instead of always going to the Saloon after he closes his shop, he'll also visit some nice spots around Pelican Town (Town, Beach, and Forest) to relax.[/size]


[size=5][b][u]Norm's gift tastes[/u][/b]
[/size]
[size=3][spoiler]Love: Rhubarb Pie, Spaghetti, Rice Pudding, Pale Ale, Pickles, Birch Water (SVE)

Like: Sugar, Wheat Flour, Oil, Birch Syrup (SVE), his own products
[/spoiler][/size]

[size=5][b][u]Norm's schedule[/u][/b]
[/size]
[size=3][spoiler]Tuesday: at the truck first thing in the morning. Mans the truck from 8:00 until 5:00, then visits the saloon for a few hours before returning to the truck.

Tuesday (4+ hearts): at the truck first thing in the morning. Mans the truck from 8:00 until 5:00, then visits one of: the saloon, the town fountain, the beach's west pier, or the forest river.

After reaching 4 hearts, he'll ask you which is your favorite among Town, Beach, and Forest. He'll add another spot in that location to his random selection pool (so he'll go there more often):
Town: the bridge leading to the library
Forest: the east bank of the pond
Beach: the shore by the bridge to the tide pools
[/spoiler][/size]

[size=5][b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b]
[/size]
[size=3]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded's map edits.[/size]


[size=4][b][u]Also Available[/u][/b]
[/size]
[size=3]On [url=https://github.com/ichortower/NormsCountryKitchen]GitHub[/url].[/size]
